subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production dashboard publish the public-by-URL `/bay-demo` experiment with its bounded live-only state semantics?
rationale: The patch is a substantial new production-facing dashboard experience, and technical correctness cannot decide whether its discoverability, maintenance surface, and non-ledger semantics are an accepted product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the hosted experiment
options.body: Approve the discoverable experimental route after inspectable dynamic proof confirms the claimed interactions and state transitions.

options.title: Require an access-controlled preview
options.body: Keep the feature but add Cloudflare Access or application authentication before deploying it for maintainer evaluation.

options.title: Keep the prototype external
options.body: Do not add the route and persistent Bay contract to the production Worker if no dashboard owner wants to maintain it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the hosted experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the discoverable experimental route after inspectable dynamic proof confirms the claimed interactions and state transitions.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns most current-main history for the dashboard Worker and is the strongest available owner for its hosted product boundary.
